source: Common TP4056 USB-C 1 A single-cell Li-ion charger board (no official datasheet for the board; vendor listings and the TP4056 data sheet for the IC): about 26 x 17 x 4 mm overall; USB-C receptacle per USB Type-C spec 2.0 (receptacle 8.94 x 3.26 mm opening, shell depth about 7.3 mm). ASSUMED / uncertain, vary between vendors by +/-1 mm: PCB 26.0 x 17.0 x 1.0 mm (the 4 mm overall height is the receptacle 3.26 mm on a 1.0 mm board), receptacle overhang 1.0 mm, no mounting holes, tallest top part other than the receptacle 1.8 mm (TP4056 SOP-8 / LEDs), four corner solder pads (B+, B-, OUT+, OUT-) 2.0 mm from the edges; wire solder fillets up to 2.0 mm over and under the pads. Measure the owner's board.
frame: module: origin at the PCB min corner, PCB bottom at Z = 0, components on +Z, USB-C end at -X

pcb_length.source: vendor listing / task sheet: board length

pcb_width.source: vendor listing / task sheet: board width

usb_width.source: USB Type-C spec: receptacle outer width

usb_depth.source: USB Type-C spec: mid-mount / SMD receptacle shell depth (typical 6.2 - 7.35)

usb_height.source: USB Type-C spec: receptacle outer height

usb_overhang.source: assumed receptacle overhang beyond the PCB edge

pad_inset.source: assumed: solder pad centres from the board edges

pad_hole.source: assumed: pad hole diameter for wires

wire_clear.source: assumed: wire / solder fillet height above and below the pads

top_parts_height.source: assumed tallest top part other than the receptacle

notes: No mounting holes: the board is held by edge ribs/clips or a pocket. Pad order in PADS: [0], [1] are the wire pads at the far end (OUT+ / OUT-) and [2], [3] the pads beside the USB-C (B+ / B-) on a typical layout, but the labelling differs by vendor and is not used by any check; the pad positions are approximate (+/-1.5 mm). Because wires are soldered to the pads, ribs must not cover the wire_pads_* keepouts (2 mm over and under the far-end pad pair; the pads near the USB end are inside component_side). The datasheet_size tolerance is 1.0 mm because no manufacturer drawing exists: vendors ship 25.5 - 26.5 x 16.5 - 17.5 mm boards. The USB-C opening is 8.94 x 3.26 mm; the plug overmold comes from plug_usbc. Import gate: R1 PCB 26 x 17 (tol 1.0); R3 USB along -X; R4 overhang assumed (tol 0.7); R9 skipped.
